lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.29 - A Look and write

details: Look and write tests students’ grasp of the concepts, through word – picture association, and their spelling of the key vocabulary.
Look for correct spelling and neat letters on the given lines.
“I’m planning a party, but I can’t decide what sort of party to have. What do you think my friends might like to do?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.29 - B. Listen and choose

details: Listen and choose practises listening comprehension and auditory discrimination by matching the spoken sentence to the correct picture.
Look for attentive listening, correct and neat circling, and check that all students are on task.
“Here are some of my friends. Can you help me find out what they like doing?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down:

Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

Homework Check:
Have Ss open to the previous lesson’s homework. Score completion %. Conduct activity feedback and error correction. Score achievement %. 
Project Gallery:

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.85 - A Follow the path

details: Follow the path further consolidates students’ grasp of the concepts, through word – picture association, and challenges their observational skills.
Look for correct identification of the pictures corresponding to the verbs, and all the students being on task.
“Oh dear, it seems like all my friends like doing different things!”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down:

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.85 - B Look and tick

details: Look and tick helps pupils consolidate their grasp of the verb concepts and the two question types (open and closed) in the ‘I’, ‘you’, ‘he’ and ‘she’ forms.
Look for correct choices and neat ticking.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.30 - Speaking Find the Differences Stick, ask and answer. Then circle the differences.

details: Find the Differences is a kinaesthetic way of helping students consolidate the verb concepts and the question – answer structures.
Look for correct production of the target grammar (questions and answers in the present continuous), correct comprehension and pronunciation, authentic intonation and neat circling.
